subject.title: feat: add publisher follow controls and discovery

question: Should ClawHub accept publisher-follow controls and discovery as core product/API surface now, and should this follow-up wait for the base API PR to land first?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing feature over private follow-state data and is stacked on an unresolved base API PR, so automation cannot approve the product/API boundary or merge order without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land the base API first
options.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 to clear proof, docs, and conflicts, then rebase and review this UI/discovery slice on top.

options.title: Review the stack together
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally review the API, controls, and notification stack as one feature, accepting the larger private-state boundary in one pass.

options.title: Pause the follow-up
options.body: Pause or close this follow-up if maintainers do not want the base publisher-follow API direction in core now.

recommendation.title: Land the base API first
recommendation.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 to clear proof, docs, and conflicts, then rebase and review this UI/discovery slice on top.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest current-main history across the route/schema package, Convex HTTP routing, retention, and creators/profile surfaces this feature extends.
